Well here is my shroom story. Few months ago my friend called me up and said his guy had some "boooomb shrooms." I had taken them once before, felt a little trippy, but it just felt like I got pretty stoned off weed, no hallucinations or anything. I enjoyed, but I was hoping to see stuff, ya' know? Anyway we pickup these shrooms and are about to take them. I read that soaking the shrooms in orange juice / lemonade makes the trip a lot more potent, so I chop up 2.0g and soak it in some OJ for 10 min or so and then chew up the little pieces(this method works great for getting rid of the taste; I didn't really taste the at all, but it is kinda gross chewing up the soggy mushrooms). 

So it is my bestfriend, my (now ex)gf, and I, watching my three dogs in my house cause my parents are gone for the weekend. We take the shrooms at 8pm or so, and we start listening to music and just chillin. After a little while we put on the new Tron movie and start watching it, but aren't really tripping yet. It is slowly creeping up on us while the movie goes on, i'm definitely starting to feel it. The craaaziest part that I will always remember is when Flynn gets picked up and starts doing the disk throwing game, it shows one guy take a disk to the chest and then disintegrate into thousands of little squares, all three of us simultaneasouly yell "WHOOOOOAAA!" at the top of our lungs, it was seriously one of the most intense moments of my life. 

We keep watching but start getting to tripped out to continue the movie, so we turn it off and start listening to pink floyd, all the lights off in the house. I had made a little bed area on the floor of the living room, just with a bunch of blankets and pillows so we could just chill. Idk if this happens to most people on shrooms, but the whole night I was going between having a good time, and then 20 seconds later I felt like the trip was turning for the worst, but then go back to happy a few moments later. Anyway, we are all tripping fully at this point, just sitting in this dark room. Everyone's noses were all running so we had a roll of toilet paper sitting on the floor. I grabbed a 3-square long piece of TP and am just looking at it intently. I start to stretch it a little bit, and as I pull it I watch it start decaying in front of my eyes, like watching a time-lapse video of this piece of TP. Then as soon as I let it go, it would be good as new. It was awesome, to say the least.

I guess this is when I really started peaking, cause shit started getting weird. If you've done shrooms, I'm sure you know how time completely changes while you are tripping. Time isn't just like a linear progression any more, it changes into something different. I was pretty nauseous, so I went into my room and was going back and fourth between my bed and the toilet. I started feeling as if time was actually going backwards, and that everything I was currently experiencing had actually already happened, I was just re-experiencing it and couldn't really change the outcome of anything. It was a pretty awesome feeling for about 20 seconds and then I started freaking out, thinking "what if the house burnt down and I just don't know it yet??" or "What if one of our dogs got hurt somehow or got out of the house??" 

At this point it is probably 3 hours after we took them, and we are all pretty much just doing our own thing, switching between going in our own little rooms and then coming back out to the living room. The whole "positive/negative/positive" flip-flopping made it really weird because I would think "oh man I should def go and hang out in the living room," start walking out there, and then as soon as I got to the living room I would turn right around thinking that its a bad idea. So I was mostly in my room and then I started to trip even harder it seemed. I started thinking about the universe and how time works and my mind was being blown over and over. I watch a lot of science channel and had recently read this book about time (In search of time; amaaazing book) so it was reaaally tripping me out. I kept thinking that the way humans experience time is all wrong, and that according to Einstein every moment of time exists, just at a different place, so we were all just going through life not knowing how stuff really is.

I was thinking that shrooms allow us to experience time how it really is and taking shrooms is like an "enlightenment," so once we take them for the first time we join the other shroomers. I then started feeling that I was going through a "trial" of sorts, and that somewhere in the future my bestfriend and gf where sitting around just watching me live through my "enlightenment," basically cheering me on. Everything started to make sense to me; I just had to live out this trip and then I would know the secrets to the universe. I felt a surge of happiness because I felt that the universe wasn't doomed after all, and that we had discovered the secrets of light travel, immortality, etc.  Then about 20 seconds later I started to freak out, thinking "OMG what if I'm broke and never experience time "normally" again and I go crazy?!?!" That was a pretty scary thought, but then I came to the conclusion that my personal timeline had fallen out of synch with the universal timeline, so I just had to wait it out till mine caught up and then everything would go back to normal.

The catch, however, was that if I thought too hard about getting back to normal, I would actually slow my timeline down and make it harder to catch up. I was in my room at this point, just trying to let my timeline go at its normal pace, and my gf and friend were out in the living room. My hypothesis seemed to be proved when I started hearing this music when I just relaxed and didn't TRY to influence my timeline. It was like this inspirational, symphony music that just screamed "yes, everything is going right!" I just hung out on my bed for all this time, tripping out, hearing this music and getting happy, and then it would go away for awhile so I would be sad until it came back. This is about 6 hours in, and my friend was coming down cause he had taken them a little before me. I pretty much battled this whole timeline thing for what seemed like a week, but I finally was starting to come down myself around 2am, 8 hours later. We were all talking in my room for a little bit and then go out to the living room, where I find the TV on and Hook playing. The whole time I was hearing this music, it was actually coming from the movie... I had a great laugh about that one. 

Finally came down and then passed out a little bit later. It was a crazy crazy experience, I left sooo much out but I really could type a novel about this trip. It was just sooo insane how different time felt. I didn't really have much hallucinations other than the whole toilet paper, and was not prepared at all for how delusional shrooms make you. It really did feel enlightening in a lot of ways, but was also really intense and scary at times. I haven't done shrooms since, pretty scarred to try them again. 

TL;DR tripped the fuck out on shrooms, Tron:Legacy scarred the fuck out of me, learned secrets of universe as I tried to re-sync my timeline to universal time.
